$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.haxe.literals. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-LPAD-CONFLICT-SILENT
arms.note: the conflicting-`using` branch drops the whole edit set and writes no reason again, so the ledger reports the rule as one that withheld an edit without saying why

arms.name: M-GUARDED-DECLINE-MIS-ATTRIBUTED
arms.find: return UsingScan.appendUsingInsert(header, STRING_TOOLS_MODULE, edits, accepted) ? edits : [];
arms.replace: return UsingScan.appendUsingInsert(header, STRING_TOOLS_MODULE, edits, violations) ? edits : [];
arms.note: the guard's sentence is written on every finding the rule reported again, including the ones the fix had already skipped for their own cause

arms.name: M-INTERP-NULLITY-SKIPPED
arms.find: return typeName != null && printsPlain(typeName, arg, ctx);
arms.note: any argument is interpolation-safe, whatever type it has or lacks

arms.name: M-INTERP-CONSTANT-BLOCK-IGNORED
arms.note: an interpolation block holding a target-invariant constant is never flagged, so '${0} ${i + 1}' is left for nobody to clean up

arms.name: M-INTERP-CONSTANT-IN-META
arms.note: an interpolated constant inside an annotation argument is rewritten, though a metadata string is read as syntax

arms.name: M-INTERP-MACRO-ARGUMENT-REWRITTEN
arms.note: prefer-interpolation rewrites a literal inside a macro call argument, so a macro keyed by the literal's text (Lang.t) silently sees a different key

arms.name: M-INTERP-REPORT-GATE-BYPASSED
arms.find: scanSource(entry.file, entry.source, plugin, false, false, index, gate)
arms.replace: scanSource(entry.file, entry.source, plugin, true, false, index, gate)
arms.note: the report runs with the gate the fix-side re-find skips, so it names every Std.string call whatever its argument

arms.name: M-INTERP-ENUM-CONVERSION-IGNORED
arms.note: an enum abstract whose @:to or @:op member runs in the concatenation passes the gate

arms.name: M-INTERP-ABSTRACT-KIND-UNCHECKED
arms.note: any abstract over a basic type passes the gate, not only an enum abstract

arms.name: M-INTERP-UNDERLYING-UNCHECKED
arms.note: an enum abstract over any type passes the gate, Dynamic included

arms.name: M-INTERP-BASIC-NAME-UNBOUND
arms.note: a basic type name passes by its spelling, whatever declaration it binds to there
